title: MetaAgents: Large Language Model Based Agents for Decision-making on Teaming

defines.name: MetaAgents
defines.definition: A social simulation framework populated with LLM-based agents that supports multi-turn conversation and sequential decision-making for studying team formation and interpersonal choices.

problem: LLM-based multi-agent systems are largely bound to human-prescribed team compositions and workflows, leaving their ability to autonomously form teams and assign roles in social contexts underexplored.
